summary: Retry-cycle receipt 87b38a551d554c2391427dda00c4e6e4 (completed, exit 0) closes the bounded-progress basis: all eleven comparisons are complete and satisfied, with three consecutive invocations on the re-added voter never completing (witness 1200 ms window then 'context deadline exceeded' at 2501 ms, retries at 800/801 ms — all with voter true and leader 1 unchanged and no payload committed), while in each interval a proposal by never-removed node 2 returned in 0 ms and committed on all three nodes, and the same node-3 invocation returned in 0 ms and committed after the leader changed to node 2 at term 2.
